question: From what Julius was saying, Reinhard was amazing from when he was little, but was he fairly strong even without the Blessing of the Master Swordsman? Also, around how many men's strength did he have as a child?
answer: If, by 'When he was a child', you're referring to when Julius first saw him, then by that point his strength was at a level where the average royal knight couldn't take him on. Well, he wouldn't be able to defeat Julius or Commander Marcos, so in other words, he was at a level where he could defeat anyone without a name. That's without the 'Blessing of the Master Swordsman'.
